ex.en: The company's annual revenue rose by twelve percent last year.
ex.zh: 该公司去年的年收入增长了百分之十二。

words.note: revenue 指企业收入或政府税收，常用 tax revenue。

ex.en: Experts are still searching for a practical solution to the traffic problem.
ex.zh: 专家们仍在寻找解决交通问题的切实可行的办法。

words.note: solution 后接介词 to，不接 of；另有“溶液”义。

ex.en: The company held a virtual monopoly on software for personal computers.
ex.zh: 该公司在个人电脑软件上几乎处于垄断地位。

words.note: monopoly 常与 hold 连用，后接 on 或 over。

ex.en: She defeated her opponent in three straight sets.
ex.zh: 她连赢三盘击败了对手。

words.note: opponent 指比赛或政治中的对手；objection 才是反对。

ex.en: The government cut taxes to accelerate economic growth.
ex.zh: 政府减税以加快经济增长。

words.note: accelerate 指加速，名词为 acceleration。

ex.en: The teacher handed out supplementary materials to help students review.
ex.zh: 老师发了补充材料帮助学生复习。

words.note: supplementary 指“补充的”，常用 materials/budget。

ex.en: You should take his advice with a grain of salt.
ex.zh: 对他的建议你应该持保留态度。

words.note: grain 指谷粒；a grain of salt 意为半信半疑。

ex.en: She took credit for the team's success although others did most of the work.
ex.zh: 她把团队的成功归功于自己，尽管大部分工作都是别人做的。

words.note: credit 表“赞扬、学分”；take credit for 指揽功。

ex.en: Climbers at high altitude often carry extra oxygen in tanks.
ex.zh: 高海拔的登山者常携带罐装氧气。

words.note: oxygen 不可数；化学符号为 O，常用 oxygen supply。

ex.en: The injured driver was rushed to the intensive care unit.
ex.zh: 受伤的司机被紧急送往重症监护室。

words.note: intensive 表“密集的、强化的”，与 extensive 易混。

ex.en: The discovery altered the course of medical research.
ex.zh: 这一发现改变了医学研究的进程。

words.note: alter 指局部改动，改衣服常用 alter。

ex.en: The course combines online lessons with weekly face-to-face seminars.
ex.zh: 这门课程把线上课程与每周的面授研讨结合起来。

words.note: combine 常与 with 连用；名词 combination。

ex.en: This quiet cafe is ideal for studying on a rainy afternoon.
ex.zh: 这家安静的咖啡馆很适合在雨天下午学习。

words.note: ideal 后接 for 表“对…很理想”；名词指“理想”。

ex.en: It never occurred to me that he might be telling the truth.
ex.zh: 我从没想到他可能说的是真话。

words.note: occur to sb 表“某人想到”，occur 无被动语态。

ex.en: The chart clearly illustrates how prices have changed over ten years.
ex.zh: 这张图表清楚地说明了十年来价格的变化。

words.note: illustrate 指用例子或图表说明，名词为 illustration。

ex.en: He used the hose to water the flowers in the garden.
ex.zh: 他用水管给花园里的花浇水。

words.note: hose 作名词指软管，hose down 表示用水冲洗。

ex.en: Scientists have not yet found definitive proof that the diet works.
ex.zh: 科学家尚未找到这种饮食有效的确凿证据。

words.note: definitive 指“决定性的、权威的”，勿与 definite 混。

ex.en: The team is on a five-game winning streak this season.
ex.zh: 这支球队本赛季已经连胜五场。

words.note: streak 指“一连串、一段时期”，如 winning streak。

ex.en: Students often feel under great pressure before the final exams.
ex.zh: 学生在期末考试前常感到压力很大。

words.note: pressure 常搭配 under pressure，动词义为“施压”。

ex.en: I have to see the dentist about a pain in my back tooth.
ex.zh: 我后牙疼，得去看牙医。

words.note: dentist 指牙医；看牙医说 see a dentist。

ex.en: She sat by the window, brooding over what he had said.
ex.zh: 她坐在窗边，反复思量他说过的话。

words.note: brood 作动词常接 over/on，指闷闷地反复想。

ex.en: The country's literacy rate has risen sharply in the past twenty years.
ex.zh: 过去二十年该国的识字率大幅上升。

words.note: literacy 指读写能力，引申为某领域素养。

ex.en: The custom is thought to originate from an ancient harvest festival.
ex.zh: 人们认为这一习俗源自古老的丰收节。

words.note: originate from 强调来源，originate in 强调起源地。

ex.en: Her doctor sent her to a specialist in heart disease.
ex.zh: 她的医生把她转诊给一位心脏病专家。

words.note: specialist 后接 in 表示专长领域，动词 specialize 同。

ex.en: The study looks at how family background affects children's grades.
ex.zh: 这项研究考察家庭背景如何影响孩子的成绩。

words.note: background 指背景、经历；in the background 表在幕后。

ex.en: He became a millionaire by selling software he wrote in college.
ex.zh: 他靠卖大学时编写的软件成了百万富翁。

words.note: millionaire 由 million+aire 构成，指百万富翁。

ex.en: The package was damaged while in transit between the two cities.
ex.zh: 包裹在两座城市之间运输途中受损。

words.note: in transit 表“在途中”；public transit 指公共交通。

ex.en: Many adolescent boys struggle with sudden changes in mood.
ex.zh: 许多青春期男孩会因情绪的突然变化而苦恼。

words.note: adolescent 作名词指青少年，名词形式为 adolescence。

ex.en: The task was difficult; nonetheless, they finished it on time.
ex.zh: 任务很艰巨，但他们仍然按时完成了。

words.note: nonetheless 是副词，可置句首或句中，同 nevertheless。

ex.en: Old batteries must be disposed of at special collection points.
ex.zh: 旧电池必须在专门的回收点处理。

words.note: dispose of 表“处理、丢弃”；be disposed to do 表倾向。
